maturation_deltas: Operation C plus Coral Sea produce stronger practical evidence for layered search, recontact, cross-carrier recovery and carrier-airgroup reorganization. Institutional maturity remains bounded; no instant modern data link or fully portable air group is assumed.
dependency_notes: Supersedes CHECKPOINT_1942-05-06T24_v001 as current-branch execution state.
Old 80/85 Coral Sea outcome and all MI descendants remain comparison-only.

doolittle_1942-04-18.japanese_detection_effect: Effective patrol/contact is modestly earlier; launch occurs roughly 50-80 nmi farther out.
doolittle_1942-04-18.air_defense_center: 1 B-25 shot down over Japan; 2-3 additional aircraft significantly disrupted/damaged.
doolittle_1942-04-18.physical_damage: about 70-80% of historical physical bombing damage; Taigei/Ryuho damage retained.
doolittle_1942-04-18.extra_US_personnel_vs_history: about 2-4 additional dead and 2-4 additional POW.
doolittle_1942-04-18.strategic_effect: Home-defense/face pressure toward MI is slightly reduced, not removed.

mo_coral_sea.schedule: MO approximately two days earlier than historical.

tulagi.water_fighter_detachment: A6M2-N equivalent about 6-8, with 5-7 ready by 1942-05-02/03
tulagi.yorktown_strike_1942-05-04: Two strikes; Japanese base not wiped. About 3-4 water fighters and 2-3 other seaplanes lost; US about 4-6 aircraft lost.

carrier_battle.Yorktown: Found 1942-05-04 after Tulagi attack-direction cues; center 2 torpedoes + 2 bombs, mission kill; re-found and sunk morning 1942-05-05.
carrier_battle.Lexington: Strikes CarDiv5; Shokaku center 2 bomb hits and flight-deck mission kill. Lexington then found and hit by Zuikaku-centered counterstrike, center 2 torpedoes + 1-2 bombs, later lost to fire/explosions.
carrier_battle.Shokaku: Survives, navigable, flight operations impossible; repair required.
carrier_battle.Zuikaku: Hull intact; air group heavily attrited across Operation C + Coral Sea.
carrier_battle.Shoho: Survives and remains in Southeast Area.

mo_coral_sea.crace: Remaining surface interdiction is hit by Japanese base air; center one cruiser significantly damaged; force withdraws.

port_moresby.landing: Japanese landing about 1942-05-09; Port Moresby falls about 1942-05-10/11.
port_moresby.allied_personnel_center: 30th Brigade core trapped; KIA/WIA/MIA about 500-900, POW about 3000-4000, a few hundred escape. Named-officer fates remain individually unresolved unless separately adjudicated.
port_moresby.reinforcements_not_trapped: 14th Australian Brigade Group and later AA reinforcements do not arrive before fall; No.75 Sqn had already departed.

japanese_operational_state.CarDiv5: Immediately usable experienced crew-sets roughly 25-35% below MO-start level; Shokaku survivors can be compressed/reorganized into Zuikaku but cohesion is imperfect.
japanese_operational_state.southeast: Port Moresby/Tulagi/Rabaul retained with Shoho + base aviation; this can hold MO gains while fleet carriers prepare next operation.
